note: CANON: default L anchors for the 13-step neutral ramp — SKILL.md's numbers table and scripts/ramp_build.py derive from this file; re-derive, never patch the prose. Chroma ceiling is 0.02 for tinted neutrals (a design margin — color-verify gates declared-tinted at 0.06), 0 for true grey. Hue is inherited from the brand's neutral tint (if any) or set to 260° (slightly cool) by default.

chromaBell.formula: C(L) = C_max * exp(-k * (L - L_peak)^2) — peaks at mid lightness, decays toward both ends

defaults.C_max: chromaCeiling (a brand tint's C caps at it); 0 for true grey
defaults.kRationale: k >= ~9 keeps the L=0.995 end under the sRGB gamut limit for a 260° tint (~C 0.0023), so the default build never needs gamut rescue

invariants: L is monotonic decreasing from step 0 → step 1000
Per-label-unit evenness (color-verify's form): adjacent gap-to-gap ratio of (ΔL ÷ Δlabel) ≤ 1.5 — label-unit normalization makes the 50-unit end gaps commensurate, so no gap is excluded
Hue is constant across the ramp
